messages:
Aisha: uploaded a new compact proposal — 'carousel invoices' in the right column (horizontal cards), spend sparkline left, token-breakdown stacked below. PTAL :eyes:
Ben: interesting idea. carousel keeps vertical space low. UX q: how do users access older invoices quickly?
Aisha: show 3 cards then a "Show all" pill that opens a modal with full history. quick-scan vs deep-dive separation.
Carla: copy nit: change "Show all" -> "All invoices"? shorter in some locales. locale-bot: FYI single-word labels are easier for many translations.
Diego: accessibility: horizontal carousels can be problematic. make it keyboard-scrollable (arrow keys) and add role="list" + accessible name. a11y-bot flagged missing aria-live when modal opens.
a11y-bot: auto-check: 1) legend contrast at small widths fails (3.4:1). 2) scope toggle lacks aria-pressed semantics. 3) carousel not in tab order. 4) invoice cards need accessible names (include date + amount).
Aisha: thanks. I'll add keyboard support, aria-labels for cards like "Invoice March 2026, $420, Overdue", and aria-live announcement when modal opens.
Ben: token label consistency: left chart shows compact (e.g., 1.3M) but right rows show raw counts. prefer compact everywhere with tooltip for exact raw. keeps columns tidy.
Carla: agree. Also legend: propose condensed legend (3 swatches) + an overflow chip "+N" that opens a small modal with the full legend; avoids awkward wrapping.
Diego: small design ask: overdue state should not rely on color. add an icon and SR-only text ("Overdue: $X"). also ensure pill collapses at 320px — maybe hide text and keep icon + SR text.
Aisha: noted. We'll use an icon + visually-hidden text and make the visible text optional at narrow widths.
Ben: invoice actions: primary CTA = "Download" on card, split menu for PDF/CSV. keeps default quick action, lets power users pick.
Carla: localization heads-up: use short menu labels like "PDF" / "CSV" to keep translations compact. locale-bot: noted; provide context strings to translators.
Diego: telemetry: add experimental flag `billing.carousel_compact` and events `billing.carousel_open`, `billing.download_click(format)`, `billing.modal_open_history`, `billing.scope_switch`. run at 3% for 10 days. Product wants time-to-download metric.
a11y-bot: re-run checklist after changes; also recommend focus-visible outlines, high-contrast colors, and testing in TalkBack/VoiceOver/NVDA.
Aisha: microcopy under spend chart: "Estimated monthly spend. Your invoice may vary." keeps it brief.
Ben: flow question: when user changes scope to Project, swap left sparkline to project-only view and keep the carousel scoped to project invoices. keep a small breadcrumb "Org overview" to return.
Carla: breadcrumb is good. also add a subtle badge on the carousel showing the org-total vs project-total when scoped to project (small ratio).
Diego: QA checklist: keyboard-only (tab/arrows), screen reader label verification, mobile widths (320/360/412), high-contrast, and verify translations for long numbers.
a11y-bot: final note: ensure `aria-pressed` on toggle, carousel items have `tabindex=0` with roving tabindex behavior, modal uses `aria-modal` and focus trap, and popovers close on Esc.
Aisha: will update Figma with annotated diffs (ARIA, split-button, compact numbers + tooltip, +N legend modal, breadcrumb). posting new frames and a short localization brief when ready. thanks all :raised_hands:
